design_basis: V1 lacked a unique repair contrast. V2 supplemental temperature control failed during development. Neither held-out set was generated. V3 is a final deterministic athermal mechanistic reference, not a thermal population-discovery claim; validation units are unseen geometries, not seed labels.

families.name: interior-dominant hypothesis
families.large_gap: six adjacent centered columns in two consecutive transverse rows (12 sites)
families.secondary_gap: one left boundary site in same row
families.hypothesis: interior reconstruction increases failure strain more than edge reconstruction

families.name: boundary-dominant hypothesis
families.large_gap: six adjacent left-boundary columns in two consecutive transverse rows (12 sites)
families.secondary_gap: one interior site at column 11 in same row
families.hypothesis: edge reconstruction increases failure strain more than interior reconstruction

families.name: negative control
families.hypothesis: no supported geometric repair; no applicable edit is not evidence of causal rejection

development.interpretation: three exact replay labels per geometry; one independent geometry per case, zero independent thermal samples

held_out.access: unseen one-row-shift geometries; generate only after committed development predictions and analysis lock
held_out.interpretation: three deterministic replay labels; generalization is across registered geometries only

geometric_edit_rule: Same circular row-phase fit and component topology as V1; candidate sites require at least two measured nearest-shell neighbors, allowing reconstruction of each bank-adjacent row of a two-row slot. No pristine site IDs. Entire missing-site components classified by observable external-boundary connectivity.

physical_validation.fracture_rule: unchanged post-global-peak 0.65 load drop plus reference-bond-loss cluster >=4 persisting three samples; null strain if censored
physical_validation.reproducibility: one development replicate rerun fresh; same engine/version numeric outputs equal; ignore walltime/PIDs
physical_validation.open_slot_measurement: For every inferred missing component spanning at least two lattice rows, measure nearest opposing-bank distance in the central half of its x extent after NVE and before loading. It must remain above the SFLJ force cutoff; retain actual distances. One-site components and pristine controls have no open-slot requirement.
physical_validation.temperature_note: Athermal target T=0; original raw kinetic-temperature gate with its disclosed 0.01 scale remains unchanged. No relative-temperature claim at a zero target. Finite-rate motion and energy released at rupture remain measured.

heldout_timestep_refinement.arms: baseline and both applicable repairs; no-op arms remain no-op
heldout_timestep_refinement.comparison: same physical warmup/NVE duration, loading rate, horizon and sampling interval

scientific_validation.inference_framework: Deterministic counterfactual identification at fixed model/protocol. Replay SD and CV measure repeatability only. SNR is contrast relative to the unchanged 0.004 engineering-strain floor, not population uncertainty. No t interval or independent-seed confidence claim is permitted.

holdout_policy: No scientific source, protocol, geometry, endpoint or threshold changes after the development analysis lock. Freeze coarse and refined decisions before scoring private assignments. All held-out geometries and applicable arms must pass registered physical, deterministic replay and convergence criteria. No discarded cases. Failure is NOT_VALIDATED.
selection_policy: Final single registered design. No further design search if V3 fails. Development physical failure prohibits held-out generation. All negative V1/V2 outcomes retained. No amendments to V3 after its first trajectory.

inference.modes: offline deterministic registered tools initially; live inference only with successful per-action JSON provenance
inference.public_observations: identical measured geometry, protocol, curves and snapshots available to every comparator
inference.hidden: ID-family map and original lattice site identifiers only in separate private generator/scorer files
inference.validation_unit: One geometry per public case, with three exact numerical replays. Held-out row position is unseen during development. No independent thermal samples exist at T=0.

scope: Educational athermal finite-rate 2D SFLJ open-slot counterfactual reference. Validates only the held-out registered geometry shift and solver timestep convergence; not thermal robustness, population inference, broad shape generalization or real-material prediction. V1/V2 negative development findings and original four benchmark results remain unchanged.
dashboard_policy: Always separate original frozen benchmark from this study. Show registration hash, development vs held-out, validation state, cached vs fresh, seed counts, failed/censored states and model mode. Never describe NOT_VALIDATED data as a successful discovery. Preserve all arms and all seeds.
